project.title: Freshwater Metagenome from interstate stormwater runoff and creek storm flow Metagenome
project.description: Metagenomic samples from two storms of interstate runoff and surrounding creek flow both before and after interstate influence. The goal was to determine the impact of the interstate runoff microbial community on the community structure of the creek.
